note: Every source this pack is built from, with the SHA-256 of the bytes the build pins, as the pinned field says: article is a page article element, metadata-fields is the Internet Archive metadata fields this pack cites, file is the file itself. It pins those parts because a Wayback envelope and an items item_last_updated both moved between two fetches of an otherwise unchanged document (measured), and a pin over a moving part refuses a source that has not changed. bytes and sha256 are always about the pinned bytes. A source without licence evidence is not used: licenceUrl names the page that STATES the licence and licenceQuote is the sentence on it, quoted verbatim; evidence quotes what identifies the work, and in says where that quote is found - document is the source own bytes, cross-reference is another source listed here. scanUrl is where a human opens the page image a correction was read off.
